entries.name: Erbium concentration series
entries.caption: Illustrative specimen identity for nominal La2(MoO4)3:Yb,Er. Shapes and dimensions are explanatory, not a TEM reconstruction or refined dopant-site/lattice model. The 800 °C powder is source-assigned tetragonal with an unidentified minor second phase; that phase assignment is not generalized to every specimen. Actual plotted Er markers are1,2,3,4,5and7%; no6% measurement or complete changed formulation is inferred.
limitations: Illustrative identity/composition; no measured atomic coordinates supplied.
